text:
talia: heads up — during today's onboarding stress run the quickstart JS sampleapp accumulated paginators and then emitted a burst, causing a ~3s stall. repro: ./tooling/loadgen --clients 45 --pages 12 --mix embed:heavy,search:heavy

ben: which SDK version? logs?

talia: js-sdk@0.9.4. logs:
```
WARN limiter: queued (scope=global) inflight=210
DEBUG paginator: hold cursor for permit (page=6)
WARN auth: refresh started by caller A
INFO retry: immediate attempt=1 bypass_limiter=true
```

indra: bypass_limiter=true is the culprit — retry path shouldn't bypass the client limiter. Also the paginator holds the cursor while waiting which causes head-of-line blocking when one route hogs permits.

ben: quick mitigations: 1) disable bypass for auth/retry paths, 2) make limiter scope configurable (per-client or per-route), 3) add singleflight token refresh at SDK auth layer.

talia: proposal for PR:
- add limiter.scope config: global|client|route (default global to preserve compat)
- implement auth.singleflight in js-sdk auth module (Map<key,Promise>)
- add PREFETCH_NEXT_PAGE flag to sampleapp paginator so next-token fetch happens async and current page returns immediately

indra: tests required: unit tests for singleflight (concurrent callers share same promise), e2e load test in devex/load-tests that runs 40 clients for 2m and asserts p95 < 600ms and no auth 5xx spikes.

ben: also add telemetry: metric client.limiter.scope and metric auth.refresh.concurrent_count for rollout. Rollout plan: behind feature flags, canary to 5% of sampleapp runs, monitor metrics for 48h.

sdk-bot: please file an issue tagged area/devex and priority/medium; add test-e2e label.

talia: opening draft PR feat/devex/route-scope-limiter and will assign @ben for limiter parity and @indra for auth. will include repro harness and a quick CI job. :thumbsup:
